items.title: Lot overlays track basemap during lot-click flyTo
items.precondition: Map page open at default park zoom (lots visible, zoom < 19 preferred so fly includes zoom).
steps: 2. Click a lot that is not already selected.
3. Watch the 0.7s fly animation until the drawer finishes opening.
items.expected: Lot rectangles stay locked to the satellite/plain imagery for the whole flight. No frozen grid sliding over the map, and no snap/glitch when the animation ends.
items.evidence: CDP instrumentation: flyTo 17→19 produced 59 zoom frames; canvas scale matched 2^(z-17) each frame (maxErr≈0). flyTo 18→19: 85/85 frames within 0.02 of expected scale. Real lot click (B02-L268) applied per-frame CSS transforms during flight; drawer opened; overlays settled aligned.
items.notes: Search-box path crashed once on dirty MapControls/lotMatches (f.statuses undefined) — unrelated to this fix.

items.title: Drag pan still smooth without lot snap
items.expected: Lots move with the basemap during drag with no flicker or delayed snap.
items.evidence: Animated panBy([80,40]) settled with no leftover zoom scale on the lot canvas (settledClean).
